auditType: Read-only snapshot reproducibility, reference coverage, UTF-16 bounds, duplicate and displayed-guidance review

unmappedWords.reason: Source spelling has no exact mapping to canonical word; no guessed highlight or color is applied.

guidanceCorrections.issue: A shared Wasl / Silent label did not explain the initial-reading case.
guidanceCorrections.correction: Hamzat wasl is pronounced when beginning the word with its prescribed vowel, omitted when joining; gray also denotes source silent-letter annotations.

guidanceCorrections.issue: Muanaqah wording sounded as though a stop at one sign was compulsory.
guidanceCorrections.correction: Continuing past both signs is allowed; when stopping, stop at only one of the paired signs.

limits: Source agreement and valid offsets do not certify tajwid or makhraj pedagogically.
Latin is a pronunciation aid, not a substitute for hearing qualified recitation; exact source reproduction does not validate every transliteration convention.
The 34 source tajwid spans crossing changed text are omitted rather than guessed; the single unmapped word and two waqaf exceptions remain explicit.
AI compares estimated recognized words; no phonetic/tajwid expert validation or guarantee of real-time correction was performed.
No manual review of every rendered glyph or human listening assessment of all recitations was performed.
